assertions.source: Strategy I: canonical Wedderburn `+3/4·h²` + Yekutieli per-cell `−G·h²` ≈ 2.49266 (vs canonical 2.55304); Vol·λ_Yek/ℏ_q²·m_e ≈ 951 MeV; 1.4% vs CODATA m_avg vs canonical 2.9%.

description: Borromean baryon mass prediction under the Yekutieli-extended λ_scale = 5/2 + (3/4 − G)·h².  EMPIRICAL MATCH AWAITING CATEGORICAL BACKING (reclassified 2026-05-23 per audit `docs/audits/2026-05-23-yekutieli-bijection-natural-reading-negative.md`): the load-bearing cell-↔-half-sym-projection bijection at H_4 is NOT supported by natural-reading partition combinatorics (κ-half-sym sum is +0.5·h², not the claimed −G·h² ≈ −0.916·h² — different sign AND magnitude).  Composed with PR #942's substrate flavor split, the script predicts m_p ≈ 950 MeV, m_n ≈ 952 MeV — ~1.3 % vs CODATA, gap halved from the canonical-only (Family A) ~2.9 %, but the categorical justification gap means this 950 MeV match is currently a numerical curiosity (or possibly a coincidence) pending either (a) precise definition of Π_HS differing from conjugation-averaging, (b) direct Yekutieli 2015 non-abelian Stokes evaluation, or (c) sign-convention reconciliation.  Probe / comparison column ONLY — NOT a production replacement; the production prediction in `m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py` uses the PROVED canonical λ_A only.
caveats: RECLASSIFIED 2026-05-23: the load-bearing cell-↔-half-sym-projection bijection at H_4 (audit `docs/audits/2026-05-22-yekutieli-percell-conjecture-formalized.md` §Conjecture) is NOT supported by natural-reading partition combinatorics, per `docs/audits/2026-05-23-yekutieli-bijection-natural-reading-negative.md`.  Empirical κ_λ findings (Richardson-extrapolated 50 dps): κ_(4) = κ_(1^4) = 0, κ_(3,1) = κ_(2,1,1) = κ_(2,2) = 1.  Sum is 3 (consistent with Family A's 3/4·h² theorem) but is SYMMETRIC under conjugation involution, so the natural-reading half-sym projection (conjugation averaging) gives +0.5·h², NOT the audit's −G·h² ≈ −0.916·h² (different sign and magnitude).  The 950 MeV prediction therefore stands as a numerical match WITHOUT the substrate-pure categorical backing the brief claimed.  Closing the gap requires either: (1) a different operator definition for Π_HS; (2) Yekutieli 2015's non-abelian Stokes machinery applied beyond partition combinatorics; or (3) sign-convention reconciliation.  Until one of these closes, treat the Yekutieli-extended prediction as empirical-only (NOT a substrate-pure framework prediction).  Production `m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py` continues to use ONLY the PROVED canonical λ_A.
